name: Athens
summary: Cradle of Western civilization and today one of the most affordable capitals in Europe, Athens combines ancient ruins with a rapidly expanding scene of cafes, rooftops and coworkings. Greece offers a specific visa for digital nomads, and the Mediterranean climate, the Aegean Sea within walking distance and a remarkably low cost of living make it an attractive base for those looking for history, sun and good connection without spending too much.
